Match.title: Match
Match.description: A deterministic 2-player mythology trump card match with active player presence tracking.

matchId.description: Unique identifier of the match document.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the match creator.

hostName.description: Display name of the host player.

guestUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the second player, or empty string while waiting.

guestName.description: Display name of the guest player, or empty string while waiting.

activePlayers.description: UIDs of players currently connected to the match session (max 2).

matchSeed.description: Deterministic Mulberry32 PRNG seed for deck shuffling and realm rotation.

activeTurn.description: Which seat chooses the stat for the current round.

activeRealm.description: Active mythological realm granting +15 bonus to matching domains.

p1Deck.description: Ordered card IDs in Player 1 deck (top card at index 0).

p2Deck.description: Ordered card IDs in Player 2 deck (top card at index 0).

warPot.description: Card IDs held in the tie pot for the next round winner.

resurrectionUsed.description: Tracks whether each player has expended their once-per-match Resurrection passive.

gambitUsed.description: Tracks whether each player has expended their once-per-match Gambit inversion.

gambitArmed.description: True if the active turn player armed Gambit for the upcoming clash.

winner.description: Match outcome once finished, or NONE while ongoing.

lastOutcome.description: Summary of the most recently resolved clash round.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the match lobby was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest match state update.

/matches/{matchId}.description: Multiplayer match state and lobby metadata.
